elements.label: Call Air Support
elements.description:
My superiors have noted my achievements. As proof, the Soviet Air Force will come to support us and once again roar at the Germans.
[With this card you can call local air support. Only available when your air power is inferior to the enemy's. You may use this ability three more times.]

elements.label: A Cautious and Chill Air Force Officer
elements.description:
I saw her record in Great Britain in the newspapers. Now she's been transferred to the Eastern Front. Her tactics are full of chaos and temptation, and I will respond with resilience and patience.
[This officer excels at defense, is immune to weather effects, and tends to use reconnaissance tactics.]
elements.comments: 此性相用来标记这是一个敌军军官

elements.label: An Eccentric Air Force Officer
elements.description:
The sky is her canvas, and the squadron is her brush. She paints childlike lines of 'meaningless' shapes, gradually eroding our air power.
[This officer is better at offense, but will cause supply shortages for the enemy. She tends to use bombing tactics.]
elements.comments: 此性相用来标记这是一个敌军军官
